verses.1: And there was a man from Benjamin, whose name was Kish ben Aviel ben Tzoror ben Bekorat ben Afiyach ben Ishmael ben Givor Chayil.
verses.2: And he was a good man, and his name was Shaul. There is no one among the children of Israel who is better than him. He was superior to all the people around him.
verses.3: And the treasures were taken away by Kish, son of Shaul. Kish said to Shaul, “Please take one of those boys with you. Go and get those treasures for me.”
verses.4: And he passed through Mount Efrém. He also passed through the land of Shalishta. But they couldn’t find him there. Then he passed through the land of Sha’alim and Ayan. And finally, he passed through the land on his right side. But they still couldn’t find him there either.
verses.5: They came to a land of swamps and marshes. Shemuel said to his young man, “Go ahead and attack them. Then we can return, so that my father will not be left behind in this place.”
verses.6: And he said to him, “Please, there’s a man of God in this city. This man knows everything that’s said here. Now, let’s go there. Maybe he can tell us what path we should take.”
verses.7: And Shaul said to his young man, “Let us go and see what can be done. For the famine is already upon us all. There’s nothing that God’s people can do to help us.”
verses.8: And the young man gathered up all the money he had, and said to Shaul, “Look, I have four pounds of silver in my hands. I will give it to the man who belongs to God. He can then tell us what we should do.”
verses.9: In those days in Israel, it was said by the man who went to worship God: “Let us go and see the Lord. For today’s prophet will call upon the Lord.”
verses.10: And Shaul said to his young man, “Your words are good. Let’s go.” So they went to the city where there was a man of God.
verses.11: Some of them climbed up to the top of the city. They found some girls who were going out to fetch water from the river. They said to them, “This is the man who lives here.”
verses.12: And she rebelled against them, and said, “Look, there they are before you! Now, for today has come the day when the people will worship in the city.”
verses.13: When you enter the city, you will find him before the sacrifice is brought forth for eating. For the people will not eat until he blesses the offering. Then, after that, the priests will be able to eat. Now, go up, for today you will find him.
verses.14: And many people came out of the city. And there was Shemuel who went out to call them to come up onto the hill.
verses.15: And God revealed Shmuel’s voice one day, before Shaul came along.
verses.16: Now, tomorrow, I will send an man from the land of Benjamin to judge over my people Israel. He will save my people from the hands of Philistines. For I have seen that my people are in danger. Their cries have reached me.
verses.17: And Shemuel saw Shaul. And Jehovah answered him, “Behold, the man whom I spoke about to you will be trapped in my people’s land.”
verses.18: Shaul went into Shemuel’s house through the doorway. He said, “Please tell me, is this the house of the ruler?”
verses.19: And Shemuel spoke to Shaul and said, “I see that you will come before me. You have eaten with me today. I will send you away tomorrow. And everything that is in your heart, I will tell you.”
verses.20: And for the sacrifices that you have brought to Me today, in these three days, do not let your heart be sad about them. For they have been found. And all the wealth of Israel belongs to you and to all your households.
verses.21: And Shaul said, “Come, my son. I am one of the little ones of Israel’s tribes. I come from the family of the poor among all the families of Israel’s tribes. Why do you speak to me in such a manner?”
verses.22: And God took Shmul and Na’ah, and brought them into the temple. He gave them places at the head of those who were praying. There were thirty men in total.
verses.23: And Shmuel said to Tavah, “Give me back the amount that I have given you. I told you to keep it with you.”
verses.24: And the priest laid the bread on the altar. Then he placed it before Saul. He said, “Now, let those who remain eat before you.” For the appointed day had come when God said to him, “Call the people together.” And Saul ate with Samuel that day.
verses.25: And they came down from the mountain, and they spoke with Shaul about the Gad.
verses.26: And they stood up. Then Shemuel called out to Shaul, the shepherd, and said, “Stand up!” So Shaul stood up. And they both went out together. He and Shemuel were there.
verses.27: Many people came from the outskirts of the city. Shmuel said to Shaul, “Tell the boy to go ahead of us.” And he went ahead. You stand here today, and I will speak on behalf of God.
